failure_summary.description: class imbalance affects AUROC interpretation; no guidance for imbalanced subtype cohorts

edits.content:
## Class imbalance

When the cohort has class imbalance > 70:30, prefer AUPRC over AUROC and
use `class_weight="balanced"` in sklearn heads. For severe imbalance
(< 20% minority), supplement with focal loss or report per-class
recall / precision separately, not just F1.
